# Hims

> Hims is a telehealth platform providing virtual care, prescription medications, and health coaching through mobile and web applications.

Hims & Hers operates a comprehensive digital health ecosystem combining telehealth services, online pharmacy, and health coaching. The company leverages mobile-first technology across iOS and Android platforms to deliver accessible healthcare services, with leadership from industry veterans including Amazon and global operations experts.

## Key Topics

- Telehealth
- Virtual Care
- Mobile App
- Online Pharmacy
- Medication Programs
- Health Coaching
- Appointment Booking
- Member Shop
- iOS & Android
- Hims & Hers
- Healthcare Logistics
- Digital Health
- Prescription Services
- Leadership & Operations

## Core Platform

- [Hims App](https://link.app.hims.com/): Mobile app offering telehealth, medication programs, pharmacy, and health coaching services across iOS and Android

## Company News & Leadership

- [Hims & Hers Appoints Global Operations Expert and Amazon Veteran as Chief Operations Officer](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/hims-hers-appoints-global-operations-expert-and-amazon-veteran-as-chief-operations-officer): Press release announcing Nader Kabbani's appointment as Chief Operations Officer, bringing Amazon and global operations expertise to the organization
